put.description: Saves this device's layout. Send the version from GET /api/desktop or the ETag of the last save as If-Match: "n". If another tab saved in between, the answer is 412 with desktop.layout.conflict and the current version in params.version. Without If-Match the save is unconditional. The new version comes back as ETag.

patch.description: Changes several items at once, all or none. Every change names the version it builds on; if an item changed in between (for example on another device), the answer is 412 with desktop.item.conflict and the item's id and current version in params. Returns the changed items with their new versions.

AckMessage.description: Confirms a `sub` or `unsub`. For `sub`, the snapshots of matching topics follow.

ApiProblem.description:
RFC 9457 problem details as returned by every failing API call. The detail text is an English fallback;
clients show the translation of the error code instead.

id.description: Chosen by the client; echoed in the ack, snapshots and errors that answer this message.

topic.description: Topic name or pattern with `+` and `#`. A message without one is answered with an error.

ClientMessage.description: A message from the client: `sub` or `unsub` for a topic or pattern.

ids.description: Items to delete. Ids that do not exist (any more) are ignored.

app.description: Shortcuts: the id of the app it opens.

name.description: Shortcuts: the label the user gave it, or null for the app's name in the user's language.

column.description: Grid cell of the item, counted from the top left corner of the desktop.

version.description: Increments with every change. Send it with the next change of this item.

DesktopItem.description: An app shortcut or a sticky note on the desktop, shared across the user's devices.

version.description: The version the change builds on. A different current version fails the whole request with 412.

name.description: Shortcuts: the new label; an empty string goes back to the app's name.

DesktopItemChange.description: A change of one item. Fields left out (or null) stay as they are.

oneOf.description: The saved layout of this device (schema in the desktop, `version` 1), or null.

layoutVersion.description: Increments with every save of this device's layout, 0 without one. Send it as `If-Match: "n"` with the next save.

preferences.description: Window preferences of the user for every app, shared across devices.

browser.description: Browser product name from the User-Agent, if known.

os.description: Operating system name from the User-Agent, if known.

updatedAt.description: When the layout was last saved (UTC).

screenWidth.description: Width of the desktop the layout was saved on, in CSS pixels, if the layout says.

DeviceLayout.description: Another device of the user with a saved layout.

id.description: Stable across reboots and device renames: `wwn-...`, else `serial-...`, else `path-...`.

name.description: Kernel name, for example `sda` or `nvme0n1`. Can change between boots.

serial.description: Serial number as reported by the drive, if any.

transport.description: Bus, for example `sata`, `nvme` or `usb`; null for virtual disks.

readOnly.description: True when the kernel exposes the disk read-only.

id.description: Stable across reboots and device renames: `wwn-...`, else `serial-...`, else `path-...`.

name.description: Kernel name, for example `sda` or `nvme0n1`. Can change between boots.

serial.description: Serial number as reported by the drive, if any.

transport.description: Bus, for example `sata`, `nvme` or `usb`; null for virtual disks.

readOnly.description: True when the kernel exposes the disk read-only.

fileSystem.description: File system or content type, for example `ext4` or `zfs_member`.

mountPoints.description: Where the partition is mounted; empty when it is not.

DisksChanged.description: Event of `storage/disks`: disks that appeared or changed, and ids of disks that disappeared.

ErrorMessage.description: A failed client message. `id` is empty when the message could not be parsed.

EventMessage.description: A change of a topic. `requestId` is the id of the action that caused it, if any.

oneOf.description: Set when the login is complete.

totpRequired.description: True when a TOTP or recovery code must follow.

app.description: Shortcuts: the id of the app to open. Required for shortcuts, not allowed for notes.

name.description: Shortcuts: an own label, or null for the app's name.

text.description: Notes: the text, at most 4000 characters. Required for notes, not allowed for shortcuts.

fileSystem.description: File system or content type, for example `ext4` or `zfs_member`.

mountPoints.description: Where the partition is mounted; empty when it is not.

recoveryKey.description: The new recovery key. The old one no longer works.

codes.description: Shown exactly once. Each code replaces a TOTP code for one login.

layout.description: The layout now saved for this device.

version.description: Its version, for `If-Match` on the next save.

recoveryKey.description: Shown exactly once. It is the only way to reset the administrator password.

required.description: True until the first administrator exists.

hostname.description: Shown on the setup and sign-in screens, so users with several servers know where they sign in.

SnapshotMessage.description: The full current state of a topic, sent after `sub`. Only changes follow as events.

hostname.description: The host name of the box.

cpuPercent.description: Usage since the previous sample; null for the very first one.

memoryAvailableBytes.description: Memory available for new work without swapping, including reclaimable caches.

uri.description: otpauth:// URI for the QR code.

code.description: Six-digit code from the authenticator app.

recoveryCode.description: One of the recovery codes shown when TOTP was enabled, instead of a code.

appId.description: The app the preference belongs to.

width.description: Last free width of the app's windows in CSS pixels.

height.description: Last free height in CSS pixels.
